question: How many open shipping-related support tickets do our strategic accounts have in total?

input.purpose: Check tier values and sample accounts in Salesforce to define strategic accounts.
input.sql: SELECT tier_c, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN _fivetran_active THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN is_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deleted_flag FROM salesforce.account GROUP BY tier_c ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check Zendesk ticket statuses, types and priorities.
input.sql: SELECT status, type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM zendesk.ticket WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY status, type ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check tags used on tickets to identify shipping-related ones.
input.sql: SELECT tag, COUNT(*) AS n FROM zendesk.ticket_tag WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY tag ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

input.purpose: Look at how Zendesk organizations link to Salesforce accounts.
input.sql: SELECT o.id, o.name, o.external_id, a.id AS sf_id, a.name AS sf_name, a.sap_customer_number_c, a.tier_c FROM zendesk.organization o LEFT JOIN salesforce.account a ON a.sap_customer_number_c = o.external_id AND a._fivetran_active WHERE NOT o._fivetran_deleted ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 100

input.purpose: Verify Zendesk org external_id matches Salesforce account id and check strategic account versions.
input.sql: SELECT a.tier_c, a._fivetran_active, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS distinct_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS matched_orgs FROM salesforce.account a LEFT JOIN zendesk.organization o ON o.external_id = a.id AND NOT o._fivetran_deleted GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

input.purpose: List strategic accounts (active versions) with their Zendesk org match.
input.sql: SELECT a.id, a.name, a.sap_customer_number_c, a.is_deleted, a._fivetran_deleted, a._fivetran_active, o.id AS zd_org_id FROM salesforce.account a LEFT JOIN zendesk.organization o ON o.external_id = a.id AND NOT o._fivetran_deleted WHERE a.tier_c = 'Strategic' ORDER BY a._fivetran_active DESC, a.name

input.purpose: Inspect Quenmere Paper Mills account version dates and Halbrook GmbH details.
input.sql: SELECT id, name, tier_c, region_c, owner_id, industry, billing_country, created_date, last_modified_date, _fivetran_start, _fivetran_end, _fivetran_active, _fivetran_deleted FROM salesforce.account WHERE id IN ('001jyjQ3yYlKrgAPD9','001KHodrD6UyqZnaQR','001T6Wn0eXovaGLMVG')

input.purpose: Count open Zendesk tickets for Strategic accounts by shipping-related tag, with status and tag definitions.
input.sql:
WITH strat AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.name FROM salesforce.account a WHERE a.tier_c='Strategic' AND a._fivetran_active AND NOT a._fivetran_deleted),
orgs AS (SELECT o.id AS org_id, s.id AS sf_id, s.name FROM zendesk.organization o JOIN strat s ON o.external_id = s.id WHERE NOT o._fivetran_deleted),
t AS (SELECT t.id, t.status, t.type, t.subject, t.organization_id, t.created_at FROM zendesk.ticket t WHERE NOT t._fivetran_deleted AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold'))
SELECT tg.tag, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS open_tickets, COUNT(DISTINCT o.sf_id) AS accounts FROM t JOIN orgs o ON t.organization_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag tg ON tg.ticket_id = t.id AND NOT tg._fivetran_deleted GROUP BY tg.tag ORDER BY open_tickets DESC

input.purpose: Count distinct open strategic-account tickets under tag-based and subject-based shipping definitions, by status.
input.sql:
WITH strat AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.name FROM salesforce.account a WHERE a.tier_c='Strategic' AND a._fivetran_active AND NOT a._fivetran_deleted),
orgs AS (SELECT o.id AS org_id, s.id AS sf_id, s.name FROM zendesk.organization o JOIN strat s ON o.external_id = s.id WHERE NOT o._fivetran_deleted),
t AS (SELECT t.id, t.status, t.subject, t.priority, t.organization_id, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM zendesk.ticket t WHERE NOT t._fivetran_deleted AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold')),
tt AS (SELECT ticket_id, STRING_AGG(tag, ',') AS tags, MAX(CASE WHEN tag IN ('shipping','delivery','logistics','late_delivery') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ship_tag FROM zendesk.ticket_tag WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY ticket_id)
SELECT t.id, t.status, t.priority, t.subject, COALESCE(tt.tags,'') AS tags, o.name, t.created_at, t.updated_at, (tt.ship_tag = 1) AS ship_tag, (lower(t.subject) SIMILAR TO '%(ship|deliver|carrier|tracking|freight|transit|late|dispatch|pickup|logist)%') AS ship_subject FROM t JOIN orgs o ON t.organization_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN tt ON tt.ticket_id = t.id ORDER BY o.name, t.created_at

input.purpose: Check last sync times for the Zendesk, Salesforce and carrier sources to judge data age as of 2026-11-06.
input.sql: SELECT 'zendesk.ticket' AS src, MAX(_fivetran_synced) AS last_synced, MAX(updated_at) AS max_business_ts FROM zendesk.ticket UNION ALL SELECT 'zendesk.ticket_tag', MAX(_fivetran_synced), NULL FROM zendesk.ticket_tag UNION ALL SELECT 'salesforce.account', MAX(_fivetran_synced), MAX(last_modified_date) FROM salesforce.account UNION ALL SELECT 'zendesk.organization', MAX(_fivetran_synced), MAX(created_at) FROM zendesk.organization

answer.answer_summary: Our 26 active Strategic accounts have 27 unsolved shipping-related support tickets (status new, open, pending or hold). Only 13 of these have the strict Zendesk status 'open'; the rest are pending (6), hold (5) or new (3).

metrics_used.name: Strategic account
metrics_used.definition: Active (_fivetran_active) Salesforce account with tier_c = 'Strategic'; 26 accounts as of 2026-11-06. Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH was excluded because it was moved to Standard on 2026-09-22.

metrics_used.name: Open ticket
metrics_used.definition: Zendesk ticket with status in (new, open, pending, hold) and not deleted. The strict status 'open' count is 13.

metrics_used.name: Shipping-related ticket
metrics_used.definition: Ticket tagged shipping, delivery, logistics or late_delivery, or with an untagged subject that is clearly about shipment, tracking or delivery (4 tickets). Counted once per ticket.

lineage: salesforce.account (tier_c='Strategic', active) -> zendesk.organization (external_id = Salesforce account id) -> zendesk.ticket (status unsolved, organization_id) + zendesk.ticket_tag (shipping tags) -> open shipping tickets for strategic accounts
assumptions: 'Strategic' means Salesforce tier_c = 'Strategic' on the active record.
'Open' means unsolved: new, open, pending or hold. Zendesk's strict 'open' status gives 13 tickets.
'Shipping-related' means the shipping, delivery, logistics or late_delivery tag, plus four untagged tickets whose subjects are clearly about tracking, late delivery or a missing delivery.
Zendesk organizations link to Salesforce accounts through external_id = Salesforce account id. This linked all 26 active Strategic accounts.
Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH is an active Strategic account with no SAP customer number. It is included; it contributes 2 tickets.
caveats: Pending/hold tickets may be waiting on the customer, so they may not need action. The strict 'open' figure is 13.
Ticket 102956 (Galbury Steelworks, pending, urgent, 'Delay on bearings for line 8396') has no tag and was excluded as not clearly shipping-related. Including it gives 28.
Excluding Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH, which has no SAP number, would give 25.
Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH is excluded because it is no longer Strategic. Its tickets were not checked.

Some _fivetran_synced timestamps are later than the 6 Nov 2026 as-of date (up to 11 Nov). The latest ticket activity is 3 Nov 2026 18:00 UTC, so the data is about 3 days old. Sync timestamps should be checked with the data team.
Ticket status and tags are as recorded in Zendesk; I did not check them against carrier tracking events.

explanation.title: Missed a customer split across two CRM accounts
explanation.detail: Halbrook Fluid Systems has a look-alike duplicate account ("… GmbH") with no SAP number. Two of its open shipping tickets sit on the duplicate, so the customer looked healthy.

explanation.title: Read every history row of the account tier
explanation.detail: salesforce.account keeps one row per version of each account (history mode). Without filtering to _fivetran_active, accounts that changed tier appear twice, and Quenmere Paper Mills GmbH still looks Strategic.
